acceleration_on_acquisition.source_text: Acceleration on acquisition 50% of Unvested Options vest on a Change of Control

leaver_terms.source_text: If you leave as a Good Leaver, your Unvested Options lapse on your Last Working Day. If you are a Bad Leaver, you forfeit all Vested and Unvested Options.

vesting_frequency.source_text: Vesting after the Cliff Monthly, in equal instalments

23e32de1741a17b7589a979cdf5fca8ab90ab68f.text:
[F1] The letter grants 1,200,000 options, exceeding the policy limit of 989,950 options. 
[F2] The exercise price of Rs 15 in the letter meets the policy minimum of Rs 10. 
[F3] The grant date of 1 October 2026 in the letter complies with the policy requirement of on or after 15 November 2024. 
[F4] The 12‑month cliff stated in the letter matches the policy’s 12‑month requirement. 
[F5] The total vesting period of 48 months in the letter matches the policy’s 48‑month requirement. 
[F6] The monthly vesting frequency in the letter matches the policy’s monthly requirement. 
[F7] The letter does not specify the exercise window after leaving, which the policy requires to be 90 days. 
[F8] The acceleration provision of 50% of unvested options in the letter matches the policy’s 50% requirement. 
[F9] The letter’s provision that unvested options lapse on leaving aligns with the policy’s requirement. 
[F10] The letter’s provision that a bad leaver forfeits vested options aligns with the policy’s requirement.

63ed629e31158b4aaa408ea3c20f4e1d8158a8db.text:
[F1] The letter proposes 1,200,000 options, which exceeds the available unallocated pool of 989,950 options. 
[F2] The exercise price stated is Rs 15, meeting the minimum requirement of Rs 10. 
[F3] The grant date of 1 October 2026 complies with the requirement that it be on or after 15 November 2024. 
[F4] The cliff period is set to 12 months as required. 
[F5] The total vesting period of 48 months aligns with the policy. 
[F6] Vesting is scheduled to occur monthly, as required. 
[F7] The letter does not specify the exercise window after leaving, which should be 90 days. 
[F8] The acceleration provision grants 50% of unvested options upon acquisition, meeting the requirement. 
[F9] Unvested options will lapse upon leaving, as required. 
[F10] Bad leavers forfeit vested options, as required.
